title: Nextdoor to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: Nextdoor Holdings will participate in key investor conferences in November and December 2026, focusing on connecting with investors and sharing company updates.
body_markdown:
SAN FRANCISCO--Nov. 10, 2026-- Nextdoor Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: NXDR), the essential neighborhood network, today announced its participation in the following investor conferences:


- On Wednesday, November 18, management will host one-on-one investor meetings at the 15th Annual ROTH Technology Conference in New York, New York.
- On Wednesday, December 2, management will host one-on-one investor meetings at the 30th Annual UBS Global Technology and AI Conference in Scottsdale, Arizona.
- On Tuesday, December 8, management will host one-on-one investor meetings at the Raymond James TMT and Consumer Conference in New York, New York.


Nextdoor uses its Investor Relations website ([investors.nextdoor.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.nextdoor.com&esheet=54638209&newsitemid=20261110377008&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.nextdoor.com&index=1&md5=764723bdff38c044ce725c009a1ea6fb) ), its X handle ([x.com/Nextdoor](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FNextdoor&esheet=54638209&newsitemid=20261110377008&lan=en-US&anchor=x.com%2FNextdoor&index=2&md5=1fe7796797d899cbea8402599e1c3e5a) ), its LinkedIn Home Page ([linkedin.com/company/nextdoor-com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Flinkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fnextdoor-com&esheet=54638209&newsitemid=20261110377008&lan=en-US&anchor=linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fnextdoor-com&index=3&md5=a5836f82af0e487910af943911e4f64f) ), and Nirav Tolia’s LinkedIn posts ([linkedin.com/in/niravtolia/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fin%2Fniravtolia%2F&esheet=54638209&newsitemid=20261110377008&lan=en-US&anchor=linkedin.com%2Fin%2Fniravtolia%2F&index=4&md5=610e808f3d93a6e83c2191d32ae0af6e) ) and X posts ([x.com/niravtolia](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fniravtolia&esheet=54638209&newsitemid=20261110377008&lan=en-US&anchor=x.com%2Fniravtolia&index=5&md5=c2504485f59cb1a7812b5931a113dced) ) as a means of disseminating or providing notification of, among other things, news or announcements regarding its business or financial performance, investor events, press releases, and earnings releases, and as a means of disclosing material nonpublic information and for complying with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD.


**About Nextdoor**


Nextdoor (Nasdaq: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network for over 110 million verified neighbors, offering trusted local news, real-time safety alerts, neighbor recommendations, for sale and free listings, and events. Nextdoor connects neighbors to the people, places, and information that matter most in their local communities. In addition, businesses, news publishers, and public agencies use Nextdoor to share important information and engage with neighborhoods at scale.
